term: bounded schedule with first instant and no first event
definition: Controls bundles: existence of a least element of BoundedTime = Set.Icc (0:Real) 1 with value 0; positive eventTime n at most 1 for all n; a strictly earlier event for each n; an integer below every integer bound; no independentCauses edges; WellFounded independentCauses; and NoInfiniteDescendingPerSeSeries independentCauses. eventTime n is the reflected existing zenoStageTime, not an added real-time limit notion. independentCauses x y is False. NoInfiniteDescendingPerSeSeries uses the existing successor-causes-predecessor convention, with no distinctness requirement.
note: Analyst mathematical controls only, with actual Mathlib real interval and integer order. A physical event interpretation would require independent support. No source attribution.
